title: Alaigned strategy cascade bundle
description: Envelope of a strategy cascade bundle: the strategy-one-pager skill produces one, and the get_cascade connector tool returns one. Each onePagers[].content is additionally validated against the methodology's hierarchy[level].onePagerSchema.

skill.description: Name of the producer: the skill, or alaigned-app for a bundle exported from Alaigned

generatedAt.description: Date the bundle was produced, YYYY-MM-DD

methodology.description: The methodology the one-pager content follows

fingerprint.description: sha256 fingerprint of the methodology schema, what the validate-script compares a bundle to

fingerprintGeneratedAt.description: Date the fingerprint was taken, YYYY-MM-DD

attribution.description: Optional funnel attribution: one UUIDv4 per strategy run, written by the generating skill at first assembly. The artifact renderer inherits it into CTA links and the registration/import flows match it to a lead — an assist signal, never identity.

ref.description: UUIDv4 of the strategy run that produced the bundle

company.description: The organization the strategy belongs to

sourceDocuments.description: Documents the bundle was derived from

ref.description: Identifier of the one-pager, unique within the bundle; the one-pager id in a bundle exported from Alaigned

level.description: Level in the cascade: 0 for the company one-pager, 1 for the one-pagers linked to it, and so on

parentRef.description: ref of the superior one-pager; null at the top of the cascade, or when the superior one-pager is outside the bundle

content.description: The one-pager content — pillars, definitions of success, initiatives with goals, narratives and evaluation status — shaped by the methodology's one-pager schema for the level

links.description: The cascade links between the one-pagers in the bundle

parentRef.description: ref of the superior one-pager the link cascades from

childRef.description: ref of the linked one-pager the link cascades to

parentRule.description: Cascade rule on the superior side

childRule.description: Cascade rule on the linked side

parentPath.description: Path of the cascaded element inside the superior one-pager's content

childPath.description: Path of the cascaded element inside the linked one-pager's content
